task.title: PhysiqueOS Home Screen widget audit and implementation plan

result.summary: Recommend one medium V1 showing Calories eaten, Protein, Active calories, and a navigation-only Start/Resume Workout link, backed by a versioned App Group snapshot written by the app and the existing TrainingSessionAuthority.

tests.summary: Audit-only task; no shipping code changed and no Xcode build/test was run while Build 78 was active. Final Build 78 source and handoff were reconciled read-only after it became VALID.

review.summary: Read-only audit of Apple documentation, current Native/Server contracts, extension/generator/signing surface, data delivery options, and session authority. Synthetic mockup board rendered and inspected.

zero_write_audit.summary: No production, Server, signing, Build 78, Simulator, DerivedData, archive, TestFlight, or shipping application/widget code was changed.

decisions_required: Approve Calories eaten / Protein / Active calories for V1.
Approve saved/left workout opening Logger choice rather than auto-resume.
Approve freshness copy/thresholds and medium-only Phase 1.
Confirm the App Group identifier before capability registration.
unexpected_findings: The canonical Home read does not contain daily nutrition/activity totals; those live in separate production nutrition/activity resources.
The existing rotating refresh credential is app-Keychain-only and when-unlocked, making direct widget Server fetch a poor V1 fit.
The existing WidgetKit extension can host the Home widget as a second WidgetBundle configuration without a second target or bundle id.
backlog: After Founder decisions, implement Phase 0/1 from final Build 78 authority and require physical-device widget acceptance.
recommended_next_step: Approve the bounded metric/behavior/signing decisions, then implement the medium widget from final Build 78 authority using an App Group snapshot and navigation-only Start/Resume links.
